import re
def cursor_slots(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']<=10 and n['pixels']>0:
            b=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b)
            c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            if 47<=r0<=61 and c1-c0<=5:
                # slot index: glyph centers at cols 17,24,31,38,45
                slot = min(range(5), key=lambda i: abs((c0+c1)/2 - (17+7*i)))
                out['blue' if r0<50 else 'pink']=slot
    return out
